description:
This beautifully presented three/four-bedroom townhouse offers bright and spacious accommodation in a convenient location close to the heart of Kilbeggan. Finished to an excellent standard throughout, the property combines a contemporary interior with a flexible layout, two balconies and reserved parking, making it an attractive turnkey option for first-time buyers, families, downsizers or investors.

Extending to approximately 1,313 sq. ft, the accommodation opens with a bright and welcoming entrance hall finished with tiled flooring, built-in storage and a hotpress. A particularly versatile room at this level can be used as a comfortable living room or fourth bedroom, with a bathroom conveniently positioned nearby.

The impressive L-shaped open-plan kitchen, dining and living area is bright and generously proportioned. this excellent living space has a fully fitted kitchen with breakfast counter and a range of appliances including oven, hob, extractor fan, washing machine, dishwasher and fridge freezer, all of which are included in the sale. Access to balconies on both sides allow plenty of natural light in the room. 

A spacious bedroom, currently utilised as a home office is ideally suited to those working remotely. The family bathroom is fitted with a panel bath and shower, WC and wash hand basin.

The upper level provides two particularly generous bedrooms. The principal bedroom is bright and spacious with laminate flooring and comes en-suite, while the remaining bedroom is also generously proportioned and finished with laminate flooring. Additional storage is provided off the landing.

Externally, the property enjoys mature communal areas together with a designated parking space and additional guest parking. A service charge of approximately €600 per annum applies.

The property enjoys an excellent location within easy reach of the shops, services and everyday amenities available in Kilbeggan. The M6 motorway is approximately five minutes away, providing excellent connectivity throughout the Midlands and beyond. Tullamore is approximately 10 minutes away, Athlone approximately 15 minutes and Mullingar approximately 20 minutes, while Dublin and the M50 are readily accessible for commuters.

Combining generous accommodation, a flexible three/four-bedroom configuration and excellent transport connections, this attractive townhouse offers an excellent opportunity to acquire a spacious and well-maintained home in a highly convenient Midlands location. Early viewing is highly recommended.
